description: Repaint this south-eastern corner as one continuous coastline seen from above, where the land's corner meets the open sea. Green land with sandy beaches in the upper-left should give way through pale turquoise shallows into open teal sea filling the lower-right, with any small islands kept. Remove the straight vertical and horizontal boundary lines and the abrupt beach cut-off; no straight line or speckled band should remain. Keep the same green, sand and teal palette and the same pixel-art style as the surroundings.
